units: mm (STL is unitless; select millimetres on import)
part_frame: First opening centre is origin, first opening in XY plane. Centreline c(t)=[R*(1-cos(t)),0,R*sin(t)], t=0..30deg. Z upward.
mass_note: Mass is supplied separately for controller load data; density/material are not inferred from STL volume.

models.model_assumption: Circular OD215, inner diameter185, wall15, Z-height150. A 30deg bend and centerline radius192.5 are explicit design assumptions, not measured from video. Height=(R+r)*sin(30deg)=150. No ellipse or flattened cross-section.

validation.validation_scope: Topology, winding, positive volume and nondegenerate facets. RobotStudio import and robot reach/collision are not yet tested.

contacts.name: C_pick1_side
contacts.surface: outer material surface, away from open ends
contacts.approach_rule: approach_position = contact_position + clearance_mm * outward_surface_normal; move toward contact along -normal
contacts.qualification: Geometric contact candidate only. Cup diameter, curvature, interference and vacuum performance require validation.
